correctness.rationale: The normalized Fock monomials diagonalize both separately radial symbols. Gamma(n+1,1) square-root CLT gives c_n(omega)=exp(-omega^2/2)cos(2omega sqrt(n+1))+o(1); Weyl summation of exp(ic sqrt n) gives O_c(sqrt N). Thus irrational locked phases equidistribute on T^2, rational p/q on a 1-torus and separated coordinates on T^2 for both square/triangular cutoffs. A mixed zero Fourier character requires p occurrences of cos(qt) and q of cos(pt), so the first discrepancy is precisely centered order p+q with formula binom(p+q,p)A^p B^q/2^(3(p+q)-1). The connected image of tail frequencies gives the locked Fredholm essential interval and odd/odd parity criterion; eta=2 has its asserted strict lower-edge jump. Checked exact Fourier coefficients independently for reduced (p,q)=(1,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,5), all orders through p+q. Finite moment checks do not substitute for the infinite equidistribution proof.
